about565.heroCopy: We've built our nombre through victories, adapted when el challenge changed, y kept moving forward. We're proud de our strength, honest about our imperfections, y here a enjoy el game together.
about565.heroSubtitle: Competitivos por naturaleza. Respetuosos por elección.
about565.heroArtworkSuggestion: Suggested: estado emblem, alianza grupo, o a cinematic battle banner
about565.trackRecordCopy: Our history gives us something a be proud de. It also reminds us that staying strong means continuing a adapt.
about565.battlesDescription: Optional: añadir Volcano War screenshots, victory records, o a battle collage
about565.storyKicker: La historia detrás de las victorias
about565.storyCopy: El poder nos trajo hasta aquí. La estrategia nos hace crecer.
about565.storyParagraphOne: For a long time, we were strong enough a bulldoze our way through events. Planning wasn't always necessary when our poder spoke para itself.
about565.storyParagraphTwo: Then other states started catching up. We had a think differently, coordinate better, y learn a use our strengths more carefully. So we did — y el wins kept coming.
about565.storyParagraphThree: We're no perfectly organized, y we don't always get things right. We simply believe that yesterday's success should never stop us de improving today.
about565.strategySuggestion: Suggested: Volcano War map, alianza formations, o a planning captura
about565.lifeSubtitle: Tranquilos en la calma. Activos cuando importa.
about565.lifeCopy: We don't need a be online all day a care about our estado. Real life comes first, but when an event starts, our people show up.
about565.rulesCopy: A strong estado needs shared expectations. These rules help us protect activa players, respect alliances, y work together.
about565.napSchedule: Saturday, Sunday y Monday · No looting within Estado 565, subject a el specific border-base rule below.
about565.napProtectDetail: No bases in Estado 565 may be looted during el state-wide NAP. This applies a everyone, including el top alliances y their farms.
about565.napParticipation: La participación importa más que el poder.
about565.napParticipationDetail: NAP protection extends a alliances con high participation. We do no segregate alliances based on poder alone.
about565.napReturnDetail: On Saturday, miembros whose bases son outside their alianza hive receive 48 hours a return. Bases still outside el hive after that period become eligible para looting under this rule, as they may have been inactiva para days.
about565.napDetail: Las bases aún se pueden defender.
about565.napDefenseDetail: Alliance miembros may reinforce y defend a base that becomes eligible para looting. In practice, this process es rarely used against activa players. It mainly helps recover resources de players who have quit el game, which can later be shared con el estado.
about565.mergersCopy: We don't force alliances a merge. If an alianza struggles because de low activity, we may recommend a merger para el benefit de its miembros y el estado. But every alianza has its own leadership, friendships, y reasons para its decisions. We offer advice, understand that circumstances differ, y respect each alliance's choices.
about565.culture: Luchamos para ganar. Nunca olvidamos que es un juego.
about565.closingCopy: We're proud de our record, honest about what needs work, y ready para el siguiente challenge. Seasons end, rankings change, y victories become memories. El people y experiences we share son what make it worthwhile.
about565.welcome: Te damos la bienvenida al Estado 565

achievements.svsDescription: El only estado among 561–576 a remain undefeated in Estado vs. Estado, according a our record.
achievements.563Description: We faced Estado 563 twice y came away victorious on both occasions.
achievements.hardDescription: Nuestra primera victoria en la Guerra del Volcán llegó en el Modo Difícil, enfrentándonos a tres estados al mismo tiempo.
achievements.twoVtwoDescription: In our second Volcano War, we fought alongside Estado 567 against Estado 571 y dominated el battle together.

principles.improveDescription: We were once strong enough a win through raw poder alone. As others caught up, we learned a plan, coordinate, y fight smarter.
principles.realLifeDescription: We son no online around el clock. We have work, families, responsibilities, y lives outside el game. When events begin, we show up.
principles.banterDescription: We joke, tease, y compete. But there es a difference between having fun y making someone feel unwelcome. We believe that difference matters.
principles.peopleDescription: We want a win, but never at el cost de el community. No event o ranking es worth making people miserable in a game meant a be enjoyed.
